supported_claims: Exact finite 3312 sequence source distributions and nine AIC/BIC model selection probabilities.
AIC/BIC choice disagreement flips penalty preference at sample sizes 4 versus 10.
For the fixed q0=1/5 and counts considered, n=6 has zero AIC/BIC disagreement.
Boundary MLE plug-in forecasts can assign zero probability to possible future outcomes.
limitations: Artificial Bernoulli complete probability space; no actual random trials.
No original paper model fit replication, no reliable out-of-sample selection superiority claim.
No external real behavioral or historical evidence.
